scope: Public primary and official sources directly used by this reproduction packet.
claim_ceiling: A checked source supports only the stated locator-level claim. It does not validate the local protocol, reducer, fixture, or result.

sources.title: JSON Schema: null
sources.supports: JSON null is a present value and is not equivalent to an absent property.

sources.title: International Vocabulary of Metrology, third edition (VIM3), annotated online edition
sources.publisher: Joint Committee for Guides in Metrology
sources.supports: The cited clauses distinguish measurement result, calibration, resolution, discrimination threshold, and step response time.

sources.title: FHIR R4 Observation: Detailed Descriptions
sources.supports: FHIR R4 separates an observation value from an explicit reason why an expected value is absent.

sources.title: State Chart XML (SCXML): State Machine Notation for Control Abstraction
sources.supports: SCXML defines event-based state transitions and legal state configurations.

sources.title: TLA+ Tools
sources.supports: TLC is established tooling for explicit-state checking of TLA+ specifications.

sources.title: NIST/SEMATECH Engineering Statistics Handbook: reliability or survival function
sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.supports: The ordinary survival function is probabilistic and describes survival beyond time t; a bounded observation period can produce censored rather than fully resolved lifetime data.

sources.title: Ajv JSON Schema validator v8.20.0
sources.supports: The packet pins the identified validator implementation rather than treating a schema declaration as executed validation.

sources.title: A Formal Verification Framework for Runtime Assurance
sources.supports: Runtime assurance separates an advanced component from a trusted safety component that can assume control when a safety property is threatened.

local_constructions: Compatible_P and Survive_H are proposed local definitions, not quotations from the cited sources.
The observation presence algebra and resource cost vector are proposed local contracts.
The concurrency result classes and effect-finality vocabulary are proposed local contracts.
